content.short: Kresus SuperApp is the first self-custody crypto and NFT SuperApp.
content.description: Kresus SuperApp ensures you never get locked out, even if you lose access to your email. Built for the end user, it blends clear, human-friendly design with a fully non-custodial security model that gives you complete control over your digital assets. Like a hardware wallet without the hardware, it delivers strong protection without the need to remember passphrases or fear being locked out. The Kresus Vault combines MPC and Account Abstraction to enable premium self-custody. Available on the iOS App Store today!
